sql: WITH RECURSIVE calendar(d) AS (SELECT date('2017-01-01') UNION ALL SELECT date(d,'+1 day') FROM calendar WHERE d<'2018-08-29'), daily AS (SELECT date(o.order_purchase_timestamp) d, COUNT(*) units,SUM(i.price) revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name=t.product_category_name WHERE t.product_category_name_english='toys' AND date(o.order_purchase_timestamp) BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2018-08-29' GROUP BY 1), train AS (SELECT c.d,julianday(c.d)-julianday('2017-01-01') x,coalesce(units,0) y,coalesce(revenue,0) revenue FROM calendar c JOIN daily USING(d)), stats AS (SELECT count(*) n,sum(x) sx,sum(y) sy,sum(x*x) sxx,sum(x*y) sxy,avg(x) mx,avg(y) my FROM train), model AS (SELECT (sxy-sx*sy/n)/(sxx-sx*sx/n) b,my-(sxy-sx*sy/n)/(sxx-sx*sx/n)*mx a FROM stats), forecast(d) AS (SELECT date('2018-12-03') UNION ALL SELECT date(d,'+1 day') FROM forecast WHERE d<'2018-12-10'), predictions AS (SELECT d,a+b*(julianday(d)-julianday('2017-01-01')) yhat FROM forecast CROSS JOIN model), smooth AS (SELECT c.d,avg(p.yhat) ma FROM predictions c JOIN predictions p ON p.d BETWEEN date(c.d,'-2 day') AND date(c.d,'+2 day') WHERE c.d BETWEEN '2018-12-05' AND '2018-12-08' GROUP BY c.d) SELECT n,a,b,(SELECT sum(ma) FROM smooth) sparse_calendar_answer FROM stats CROSS JOIN model
